packageRules.description: mdformat-tables 1.0.0 requires mdformat<0.8, so mdformat 1.x can't install with it (that is why mdformat is pinned to 0.7.22); re-enable when mdformat-tables supports mdformat 1.x
A Leaflet PR only bumps VERSION: never automerge it, the vendored files are updated by hand on its branch
prBodyNotes: This PR only bumps `vendor/leaflet/VERSION`. Before merging, run the update procedure in the README section "Vendored Leaflet" on this branch so the vendored files match the new version.
